 XXXIX ACMM, Bengaluru.
 : JUDGMENT :
The PSI, Adugodi Police Station has submitted the present charge sheet against the accused No.1 and 2 for the offences punishable U/Sec.323, 324, 504 r/w Sec.34 of IPC 2.

The brief facts of the prosecution case is as follows:
That on 26.06.2019 at 4.00 pm when Cw1 parked his autorikshaw in front of his house, the accused No.1 and 2 along with two others sat in the autorikshaw and they were smoking.

When Cw1 questioned it the accused persons along with two others picked up quarrel with Cw1, abused him with filthy language and assaulted Cw1 with hands and clubs, when Cw2 came to the rescue of Cw1, the accused persons also assaulted Cw2 with clubs.

As such Cw1 lodged a complaint as per Ex.P.1.
3.
A Case is registered in Adugodi Police Station as Crime No.111/2019 for the offences punishable under Section 323, 324, 504 r/w Sec.34, 506 of IPC
After completion of investigation charge sheet has been filed against the accused No.1 and 2 for the above said offences and this court has taken cognizance for the above said offences.
4. The accused No.1 and 2 appeared through their counsel and they have been enlarged on bail.
Prosecution papers were furnished to accused No.1 and 2 as required under Section 207 of Criminal Procedure Code.

Heard both sides, charge has been framed against accused No.1 and 2 read over and explained the contents to accused No.1 and 2 in the language known to them, wherein the accused No.1 and 2 pleaded not guilty and claims to be tried.
5. In order to prove the case of the prosecution, it has examined two witnesses as PW-1 and PW-2 and got marked Ex.P-1 to Ex.P.3 documents.

After completion of prosecution evidence, statement of accused No.1 and 2 as required under section 313 of Criminal Procedure Code is dispensed as no incriminating evidence appeared against accused No.1 and 2.
6.
Heard arguments and perused the material on record.

sentences.text: Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable doubts that, on 26.06.2019 at 4.00 pm when Cw1 parked his autorikshaw in front of his house, the accused No.1 and 2 along with two others sat in the autorikshaw and they were smoking.

When Cw1 questioned it the accused persons along with two others picked up quarrel with Cw1, abused him with filthy language and assaulted Cw1 with hands and clubs, when Cw2 came to the rescue of Cw1, the accused persons also assaulted Cw2 with clubs, as such the accused No.1 and 2 has committed offences punishable under Section 498A, 324, 504 of IPC?
2.
What order?

8. My answer to the above points are as follows:
Point No.1 : In the Negative, Point No.2 : As per the final Order.
For the following, REASONS 9. Point No.1 : It is the case of the prosecution that, on 26.06.2019 at 4.00 pm when Cw1 parked his autorikshaw in front of his house, the accused No.1 and 2 along with two others sat in the autorikshaw and they were smoking.

When Cw1 questioned it the accused persons along with two others picked up quarrel with Cw1, abused him with filthy language and assaulted Cw1 with hands and clubs, when Cw2 came to the rescue of Cw1, the accused persons also assaulted Cw2 with clubs.
10. According to the prosecution PW-1 is the complainant cum injured.
PW-2 is a injured eye witness.

The prosecution has produced and got marked Ex.P.1 complaint and Ex.P.2 spot panchanama, Ex.P.3 statement of Pw2.
11.
In support of the case of prosecution, it has examined Cw1 / Mohammed Saleha examined as PW-1, who deposed before the court that he knows the accused persons.
As there was a oral quarrel took place between himself and accused persons, as such he has lodged complaint against accused persons due to anger.
The accused persons have not abused him with filthy language nor assaulted him nor Cw2 with hands or with any article.
He has put his signature to Ex.P.1 complaint which was prepared by the police.
He do not know the contents of Ex.P.1.
He has put his signature to Ex.P.2 at the police station at the request of the police.
No panchanama was conducted in his presence and no article was seized in his presence.
He do not know the contents of Ex.P.2.
Even though the PW-1 is treated as hostile and permitted the prosecution to cross examine the witness, nothing worth has been elicited from the mouth of said witness.
12. Cw2 / Akram Pasha examined as PW-2, who deposed before the court that he knows the accused persons.
As there was a oral quarrel took place between Cw1 and accused persons, as such Cw1 has lodged complaint against accused persons due to anger.
The accused persons have not abused Cw1 with filthy language nor assaulted him nor Cw1 with hands or with any article.
He has not given any statement to the police.

13. The prosecution has examined 02 witnesses out of its list of 07 witnesses.

As the complainant /
injured and injured eye witness turned hostile as such remaining witnesses were dropped.
According to prosecution PW-1 is the complainant/ injured deposed before the court that he knows the accused persons.
As there was a oral quarrel took place between himself and accused persons, as such he has lodged complaint against accused persons due to anger.
The accused persons have not abused him with filthy language nor assaulted him nor Cw2 with hands or with any article.
He has put his signature to Ex.P.1 complaint which was prepared by the police.
He do not know the contents of Ex.P.1.
He has put his signature to Ex.P.2 at the police station at the request of the police.
No panchanama was conducted in his presence and no article was seized in his presence.
He do not know the contents of Ex.P.2.
According to the prosecution Pw2 is a injured eye witness deposed before the court that, he knows the accused persons.
As there was a oral quarrel took place between Cw1 and accused persons, as such Cw1 has lodged complaint against accused persons due to anger.
The accused persons have not abused Cw1 with filthy language nor assaulted him nor Cw1 with hands or with any article.
He has not given any statement to the police.
Even though the witness PW-1 and PW-2 were treated as hostile and permitted the prosecution to cross examine the witnesses nothing worth has been elicited.
As the material witnesses have not whispered a single word against the accused No.1 and 2, as such the prosecution failed to prove the guilt of the accused No.1 and 2 beyond all reasonable doubt.
Hence, I answer point No.1 in the Negative.
14. Point No.2:

In view of my findings on Point No.1 in the Negative, I proceed to pass the following:
:ORDER:
Acting under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C accused No.1 and 2 are hereby acquitted for the offences punishable under Section 323, 324, 504 r/w Sec.34 of IPC His bail bond and surety bond stand cancelled.
 Property shown at PF  No.66/2019 being worthless shall
be destroyed after expiry of  appeal period.
(Dictated to the Stenographer directly to the computer, typed by her, corrected and then pronounced by me in the open Court on this 16TH APRIL 2024 ).
(Vijeth .V) XXXIX ACMM, Bengaluru.
